_comment: Android update manifest. Each release: bump versionCode in build.gradle.kts AND here, then upload the APK with: gh release upload current Wander.apk --repo faisal-nabulsi/wander-site --clobber (binaries are NOT committed to this repo).
notes: This update needs a fresh install, just once. Tap Later, uninstall Wander, then download it again from wanderspoofer.com/download and install it. Sign in afterward and your saved places come back. After this, updates install normally again.
